name: com.qiyukf.android.extension.servicekeeper.service.ipc.server.IPCCommunicationAndroidService
description: When Qiyu customer-service extension modules connect, this Service supplies a private channel for registering extensions and exchanging messages. It runs behind the scenes and is not a screen users open.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the communication channel used by dependent Qiyu modules, so customer-service functions that use those modules stop working.
